sloka: रुदन्तौ रुदतीम् दुःखात्समेत्यार्याम् मनस्स्विनीम् ।भरतम् प्रत्युवाच इदम् कौसल्या भृश दुह्खिता ॥२-७५-१०॥
transliteration: rudantau rudatīm duḥkhātsametyāryām manassvinīm ।bharatam pratyuvāca idam kausalyā bhṛśa duhkhitā ॥2-75-10॥

translations.english: Looking at Bharata, the deeply afflicted Kausalya said, The kingdom which you had desired has been acquired without any obstacle. Alas Kaikeyi had quickly secured it for you through her crooked act.
